title: Golden Age
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Prosperity: the empire growing with nothing threatening it. Lowest tension in the library paired with high energy and near-maximum valence, a corner nothing else occupies -- Technology! sits at the same calm but only half the optimism, so a research push alone will not reach this. It takes growth AND commitment together, which is what a golden age actually is.  Editable source: data/audio/midi/Golden Age.mid
